seen_animation: A single line-drawn popsicle (rounded bar, short off-centre stick, a small tick where the bar's bottom edge overhangs on the left) hangs in the air over a grey perspective floor grid with three outline clouds. In frames 1-4 it leans steeply to the right with the stick pointing down-left; over frames 4-6 it turns slightly toward upright, the stick swinging to point more straight down, then it holds that pose for the rest of the shot. From about frame 11 grey vertical curtains with zigzag hems slide in from the left and right edges and by frame 16 cover roughly the outer quarter of the frame on each side. The popsicle does not change size or position while the curtains close.
seen_film: A chocolate-coated ice-cream bar on a stick floats over a pink-and-blue checkered floor under a sky with clouds. In frames 1-2 the words ESKIMO PIE fade out behind it. In frames 1-3 the bar is tilted further and turns slightly toward a steadier, less tilted angle by frame 4, then hangs nearly still. From frame 11-12 striped blue curtains enter from both side edges and close inward through frame 16, while the bar stays in place.
named_subject: A popsicle / ice-cream bar on a stick (an Eskimo Pie bar).
evidence: e.png 1-6: the bar rotates in small even steps from the steeper tilt to the less tilted pose, matching the film's turn over f.png 1-4 (the animation finishes about two frames later). e.png 6-26: the bar holds the same pose, size and place, as in f.png 5-26; g.png shows all drawings from frame 4 on stacked on one centre with only the early frame offset, so there is no reversal or jump. e.png 19-26: curtains enter from both sides and close inward at the same rate and extent as f.png 18-26. The drawing keeps the doodle's construction in every frame: narrow rounded top, wobbly single contour, overhanging tick at the lower left of the bar, short stick set to one side. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: The opening turn finishes around frame 6 instead of frame 4 as in the film, and the curtains appear one frame later (frame 19 versus a thin edge already visible in film frame 18).
closes_when: The bar reaches its held angle by e.png frame 4 and a curtain edge is visible at both sides in e.png frame 18.
protect: The doodle's exact line construction (wobbly contour, left overhang tick, off-centre stick); the small evenly spaced rotation steps in frames 1-6; the stable hold with no size change or redraw flicker; the curtains closing from both sides at the film's pace; the bar's placement in frame matching the film.
identity_gap: None of consequence: the bar is the c.png doodle tilted to the film's angle, with its tick, contour wobble and stick placement kept.
